paper_metadata.title: Formation of eutectic (γ' + α) and α transformation in Ta-bearing high W content cast Ni-base superalloys

alloy_systems.name: low Cr high W cast Ni-base superalloy

mechanisms.name: eutectic reaction L -> gamma + gamma prime

evidence.quote: Because Ta and Al are strong positive segregation elements and c0-formers, the (Al,Ta)-rich residue liquid can reach the eutectic (c + c0) composition and promotes the reaction of L ! c + c0 in the late stages of solidification.

mechanisms.name: eutectic reaction L -> gamma prime + alpha

evidence.quote: During the formation of eutectic c0, W and Mo were rejected into the residue liquid pool. Meanwhile, the concentration of (W + Mo) dramatically increased followed by a eutectic reaction of L ! c0 + a.
